item.content:encoded:
SCP-5129 is a male horse who has the ability to open a pocket dimension inside its underbelly. SCP-5129 is normally friendly and isn't easily agitated. due to the side affects of the pocket dimension, It will go on a rampage once a week. This rampage usually lasts 1-2 hours. During the rampage, The pocket dimension opens and disembodied arms and hands burst from SCP-5129. Before recovery, these arms pillaged villages in Greece while SCP-5129 is on its rampage. The foundation members managing SCP-5129's containment cell have given it the nickname, Trojan horse.

Deleted at -20 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

dankaar

+ show block
– hide block

Hoo boy…

SCP-5129 is to be kept in a 15m x 15m Titanium room

Aaand that's a downvote. Titanium shouldn't be capitalized. Horses generally need two acres of land- about 8km2 of land. 15mx15m is about 225m, far too small. Finally, titanium is only useful if you need something both light and strong. Otherwise, reinforced steel is almost always going to be better.

Steel shackles are to be locked to SCP-5129 hind legs to at least slow it down.

… how? I mean, how is this supposed to slow it down? Also; bad tone. "The rear legs of SCP-5129 are to be shackled to inhibit its maximum speed" is better.

Reinforced sliding steel doors are locked in place when SCP-5129 goes on its rampage.

… See, now this would be an appropriate use of titanium or (more likely) a steel/titanium alloy. Regardless, unless material requirements are of the "substitutes WILL cause a breach" nature, you're likeoy better off not mentioning them.

Also, "rampaging" or rage states aren't really seen as interesting. They're boting, and generally never used now.

Two foundation agents who have taken courses on exorcism and have been dispatched by their teacher are to be kept at SCP-5129's containment cell at all times.

… what kind of exorcism? Shinto exorcisms are much different than catholic exorcisms. Furthermore, based on the SCP, it's unclear how an exorcist or someone with exorcist training would help here, as the idea of an exorcist is to banish evil spirits/demons from a host, object, or place.

As for the SCP itself, you've basically failed to understand ancient greek mythology. They have three seperate sections of Hades, the underworld. First, the greeks had Elisyum, a paradise where the truly blessed and honored would go upon death. Then you have Tartarus, their equivalent of hell where the Titans and those who commited truly reprehensible acts would go for eternal torment. Finally, you had Asphereus, where everyone else went; neither reward nor punishment, the souls of people sent here would be wandering aimlessly, forever caught up in the moment of their demise unless stirred out of it by mortals visiting the place.

None of these places are said to resemble what you described in the exploration.

Furthermore, a creature like this would most likely be associated with Ares, the God of War, not Hades, the God of Death, considering its habit to raid and pillage its local environs.

I strongly recommend you go to the site forums and work on the core concept of this, rather than go to the draft stage. The flaws of this SCP are fundamental in nature, beyond what I've mentioned, and attempting to draft it without focusing on the core concepts first will make it harder to fix.

SCP 5127 was discovered in Chaco, Argentina in 2003 after civilians were consistently reporting deceased people rising from their graves.

SCP 5127 consists of SCP 5127-1 and SCP 5127-2. SCP 5127-1 is a strangely shaped book with covers made of an unknown harmful white substance and pages are made out of leather. The object appears to have the ability to resurrect deceased people.

Deleted at -23 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Iamwords2E

+ show block
– hide block

Format is confusing, you don't need to press enter every 2 lines that is just not how paragraphs work. Labeling of the instances is confusing, SCP-5127-2 and SCP-5127-3 could have their designations switched and it would flow better. Sentences are to simple and could be worded better so they are not as awkward. The SCP itself has little meat to and could use some plot (doesn't have to be a heavy one though) since at this point it is just the Necronomicon. You definitely have room for improvement but your asking for help is good sign. Though it is not recommended that you post articles on the main site of critique; The Wiki Sandbox in which drafts are posted for critique by designated wiki staff. Though I will warn you that it will likely be slow to hear a response though they are one of the better at giving critique that most other sources (even me). I hope this helps.

SCP-5136 is approximately 4 kilometers in length, 2 kilometers in width, and 100 meters in height, this anomaly is located in the Bahamas and is labeled “The Bahama Wonders Hotel”, the anomaly appears as a hotel, when the subject enters the Hotel they will be greeted by a man behind the desk, designated SCP-5136-1, he will be wearing formal attire. He will ask if the subject wishes to rent a room, if the subject says they are not they will be thrown out of the building from a strong force of wind, if the subject says they are looking for a room SCP-5136-2 will bring them to a random hallway, regardless if it is full or not, each hallway contains 40 doors leading to a room, these rooms are designated SCP-5136-2. For more information, read Addendum 1/332/CAI.

Deleted at -24 and three votes.

SCP-5156 is a mutated virus that came from an unknown planet. It's appearance is a genderless Humanoid-shaped figure that has arms twirling uncontrollably every second for an odd reason. SCP-5156's capabilities are yet to be understood, but the one discovered is regeneration. SCP-5156's regeneration from wounds and such is absurd, it has come to a point where SCP-5156 can regenerate a limb for approximately 3 seconds. Sightings of SCP-5156 have been spotted in ██████. Thankfully, only a handful of people saw it. Further research of SCP-5156 is ordered by the 05 Council. Reports and Investigation will be available to those of Level 4+ Clearance.

Deleted at -20 and three votes.

The supplementary pages SCP-5156 Investigation 001 and SCP-5156 Research Log 001 have likewise been deleted at -19 and -23 respectivley.

SCP-5234 resembles the nozzle of a common garden hose at its shortest length, but can expand and will most often be seen around 10 centimeters long. The "hose" will grow indefinitely, but its rate of growth differs depending on the environment. When any part of the "hose" is near plant life, SCP-5234 will rapidly elongate, and the longest recorded length has been one kilometer . SCP-5234 has been recorded to grow quicker around materials made of formerly organic material, such as wood, but it grows at its fastest rate when near live plants. SCP-5234 grows at its slowest when contained in a container of volcanic rock, with the most efficient type being obsidian.

Deleted at -15 and three votes.

Feedback Ported:

Raitia

+ show block
– hide block

It's a creative concept for a non-agressive euclid, playing with the idea of a hose snake, that literally plays a game of snake with the enviroment, but it feels… underwhelming? The rust tidbit with rusting blood feels mostly like a danger for danger's sake addition, and beyond that it doesn't really do much more than slither around and grow. The containment procedures are also unnecessarily long and don't make sense. If It grows in organic material and destroys metal, why not just stick it in something like plastic?

SCP-5187 is a paperback book of the title The Whole Art of Deduction, however instances of SCP-5187 have been located with minor alterations to the title. Additionally, the author is credited variously under names associated with the fictional detective Sherlock Holmes. Efforts to trace the origins of these books have succeeded only in uncovering now-defunct publishing companies and publication dates for each book consistent with the final year of operation of each company.

Deleted at -13 and three votes.

SCP-5961 is an anomalous entity of unknown origin, although recovered documents suggest a Germanic origin. When observed SCP-5961 appears to be being of, what has been described as, ‘indescribable beauty’ by human beings observing it. This beauty is believed to overload dopamine production in the observer’s brain, creating an addiction to seeing and pleasing SCP-5961.

Deleted at -12 and three votes.

Rewrite by BetterMyButter is pending.

SCP-5083 describes the collective designation of three humanoid entities, each possessing individual strengths and anomalous properties.

SCP-5083-1 is a tanned, humanoid male, roughly 2.2 m in height and 245 kg in weight. Subject possesses great strength, and appears extremely muscular. SCP-5083-1 is often very hateful and rude towards staff. DNA testing has proven SCP-5083-1 to be over 200 years of age. When questioned about its origin, SCP-5083-1 will get highly defensive and extremely violent, often attempting to escape containment and harm personnel in a rage.

Deleted at -16 and three votes.

item.title: Deletions 69: the seventh most populous urban area in France: Re: Deletions 69: the seventh most populous urban area in France
item.content:encoded:
Deleted an article by yoyoman337 at -20 with three staff votes, summary deletion.

Description: SCP-5603 is 5'10 male of English decent who goes by the name of "Kevin". SCP-5603 has blue eyes, has short brown hair, appears to be between the ages of 20 to 25, and according to him is "the quiet type". SCP-5603 is also observed to be very friendly but demanding. SCP-5603's ability is to always speak truthfully. if something SCP-5603 says is not true it will become true. SCP-5603 describes his ability as "Speaking the word of truth" and "Always being right", these statements have been proven to be true. SCP-5603 is immortal and cannot physically get hurt as per his statement. SCP-5603 claims to have had many names and Kevin is the name that he has liked these past couple of years. SCP-5603 has at many times used his ability to do magic tricks as it is one of the past times he still finds enjoyable. When asked if SCP-5603 plans on escaping the foundation he said "No not now anyway but maybe another time. Besides, I find this place interesting, at least until I say otherwise. Also you're going to get me a glass of iced tea." after saying this Dr.[REDACTED] immediately sprinted out of the room and burst into the kitchen to find iced tea. after finding iced tea she poured it in a glass and sprinted back spilling most of the drink. Once Dr.[REDACTED] returned with the almost empty glass SCP-5603 took it and spoke "Guess i shoulda been more specific"

Feedback is as follows:

+ TheBlueShark
– TheBlueShark

Yeah sorry, but judging by Special Containment Procedures this is not a good SCP. And making a Humanoid SCP as your first SCP because Humanoid SCPs are really hard to get right, next time try making an Object SCP. Another thing is that you have classified this as a "Keter", Keter SCPs are SCPs that are hard to contain, this SCP is very easy to contain, so this should be classified as "Safe".

+ Spaser
– Spaser

Hello I've noticed that the formatting is very off, I recommend going to the how to write an SCP page as it has a lot of resources for formatting. It is also required that new writers get their ideas greenlighted at The Idea Critique forum before writing it. best of luck.

+ Studoku
– Studoku

In future, it's best to receive feedback before posting. The forums can help with this.

You would also have been told that this is extremely similar to a season 1 skip. On the one hand, that was a pen and paper whereas this is alive so there's room for original ideas. On the other hand, you haven't included any.

I'd shelve this concept- writing an omnipotent entity is damn-near impossible for an experienced writer. It also feels like a self-insert, Kevin.

Numerous issues

  • Spelling errors such as "decent" instead of "descent". Proofread your work and get others to do so.
  • Imperial measurements. The Foundation is an international organisation and uses the metric system. That means metres and kilograms, not feet or cubits.
  • Pronouns. SCPs almost always use it/its/itself- humanising them is dangerous
  • Lack of paragraphs
  • Description is very rambly and doesn't fit the expected tone
  • The tests add nothing new to the article. They could have been used to give insight on your SCP's personality but you decided to simply state it in the description
  • Crosslinking more popular SCPs is considered a lame way to piggyback on another article's popularity. "My SCP could beat 682" is especially overdone- it gets beaten up more often than Commander Worf.
  • The interview is poorly written and, again, adds nothing that you didn't state earlier. The doctor does not feel like a real character and seems far too easily surpised by a magic trick.
  • Allowing a dangerous SCP to freely roam the facility is always a bad idea. You've got an explanation for it but all this does is paint the Foundation as being complacent an/or woefully unimaginitive. I can think of ways of containing this guy so it's ridiculous that The Foundation can't.

Deleted an article by RedReaper737 at -20 with three staff votes, summary deletion.

Description: SCP-5904 is a hallucination of a person’s greatest fear that can interact with physical object, because everyone has different fears all observers seem to observe the entity differently. All attempts to communicate with the entity have failed, the entity is unable to manifest bigger than 6x6x6 feet and seems to be able to move trough all physical objects except platinum. It has been observed killing without actually doing anything, it is thought that it’s real form is able to kill while the observed form is doing nothing. Any pictures taken of the entity have resulted in photographing what the photographer is seeing. SCP-5904 is confirmed to not be sentient and act on primal instincts like hunting.

No feedback present.

Deleted an article by Tungsten_Shampoo5782 at -17 with three staff votes, standard deletion process.

Description: SCP-5782 is a bipedal entity that appears to have been constructed out of various planks of hardwood that have been glued together forming a blocky structure that resembles a human being. SCP-5782 is 3 meters tall, ⅔ of a meter wide, and is approximately 6.35 Centimeter deep. On what would presumably be its head there is a faded, poorly drawn smiley face that appears to be drawn there with a Sharpie marker.

Feedback is as follows:

+ MightyMightyena
– MightyMightyena

This feels unfinished or only half completed. What happens to 5782-2 instances when their targets are dead? Can they be stopped? How can 5782-1 instances be saved? All this needs explaining, because right now its just "here's a thing that will kill you if you say its name and how it does it."

As a fellow first time SCP writer I highly reccommend you bring this to the Ideas Critique forum so better qualified people can give you advice and critique to make this idea more fleshed out, because right now and I am sorry to say this, it feels like not enough thought has been put into the premise.
